text:
Sophia: Heads-up — starting onboarding for new-7b-mono into staging. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/onboard/new-7b/weights-v1.2 (sharded). Tokenizer seems to have two quirks: missing pad token and aggressive pre-tokenization of leading spaces. Can someone validate serving config + run a small golden prompt pass? I also added a canary rollout in PR #452 :eyes:

Ritesh: On it. Which artifacts are the raw HF checkpoint vs our quantized artifacts? Need to confirm sharded order for the loader.

Sophia: Raw HF checkpoint tar: s3://redwood-models/onboard/new-7b/checkpoint-2026-11-03.tar.gz. Quantized dirs: s3://redwood-models/onboard/new-7b/quant/q4_[a-f].pt

Alex: Tried loading tokenizer locally — error on load: 
```
ValueError: pad_token_id not in the vocabulary
```
Quick local workaround: set `tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token` then `save_pretrained()`. But this may break some structured-output tests that assume explicit PAD.

Priya: FYI infra config in staging YAML has: 
```
model:
  chunking:
    enabled: true
  max_input_len: 4096
  kv_cache_size_gb: 8
```
Runtime validate.py gives: `ERROR: seq_len mismatch: expected <=4096 got 8192` when I tried a long prompt in smoke harness. Might be a pre-tokenize->detokenize mismatch.

Linus: Pinged eng-platform about kernel flags and the newer attention kernel. Also @qa-bot can you run the golden prompt harness with structured-output + tool-call checks? Need early signal before canary.

qa-bot: Starting golden-run (10 prompts) for new-7b-mono on staging canary. Config: structured_output=true, tool_call_timeout=2s, tokenizer_patch=none. Run id: gr-1841234567-1.

Alex: Sharing small repro for tokenizer pretokenize issue: 
```
>>> tokenizer.tokenize("  Hello")
['▁', 'Hello']  # leading space collapsed to single token
```
Expecting two leading spaces to be represented deterministically. This might affect instruction parsing where leading whitespace matters.

Ritesh: I pushed a quick tokenizer vocab patch that adds explicit `<|pad|>` mapping and a whitespace token fallthrough (PR #458). I also updated loader to preserve sharded ordering via manifest.json. Can someone review?

Sophia: Reviewing PR now — left two comments about unit tests and an explicit fallback for when pad_token missing. Otherwise looks good. Will approve if CI passes. :thumbsup:

qa-bot: Golden-run complete. Summary: 10/10 generation ok, 8/10 structured-output schema-valid, 2/10 tool_call failures (external-tool timed out). Artifacts: s3://redwood-qa-results/gr-1841234567-1/report.json.

qa-bot: Minimal failure log snippet: 
```
Prompt #7: tool_call->fetch_price timed out after 2s
Prompt #9: tool_call->lookup_kb returned non-json
```
Both caused fallback text outputs; model itself generated valid JSON in most cases.

Priya: Sequence-length mismatch fix: I found the smoke harness was sending pretokenized inputs (counts tokens twice). Adjusted harness to send raw strings. Re-ran locally, no more 8192 errors. Pushing commit to harness.

Ritesh: Re-ran golden with tokenizer_patch applied and tool_call_timeout bumped to 5s. New run id gr-1841234567-2. Results: 10/10 gen, 10/10 structured-output valid, 0 tool_call failures. Pushed updated canary artifact and manifest.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-11-04T02:15:00Z (canary=10%). Artifact: s3://redwood-models/onboard/new-7b/quant/v1.2-canary.

Linus: I'll watch SLOs and logs during the canary. Priya — can you wire up the eval alert for structured-output regression in the console (threshold 95% validation)?

Priya: On it. Creating alert: eval.struct_out.valid < 95% -> slack eng-ml + page. Also logging the tokenizer patch version in model metadata.

Sophia: Nice — thanks everyone. Action items: Ritesh will merge PR #458 after CI, Linus monitors canary, Priya sets alerts, Alex to add a short note in release docs about the tokenizer caveat. I'll follow-up tomorrow with rollout plan for Dedicated. :raised_hands:
